name: The Shillelagh
intro: An Irish-American pub in West Orange, New Jersey. Join us for live music, a pint, and a seat at the bar. Everyone is welcome.
story:
The Shillelagh is the public pub and kitchen at the home of the Friendly Sons of the Shillelagh, Essex Division, on Prospect Avenue. Neighbors come for Irish music and sport. On Friday and Saturday nights, local and regional musicians take the stage.

The Essex Division dates to 1967. Its members carry on a tradition of service through the Frank Schott Blood Drive and fundraisers for childhood cancer research through St. Baldrick’s.
